name: One Park FOUR All: The Bay's 4th Anniversary
address: 1055 Boulevard of the Arts, Sarasota, FL 34236
hours_label: Event times vary · Most events free
blurb: The Bay Park celebrates its fourth birthday with 70+ mostly free events on Sarasota's bayfront: live music, movies, dance and family activities. This week's highlight is Boo! at The Bay, a free family Halloween celebration (Sat, Oct 17, 5–7:45 PM).

name: Pinocchio at Florida Studio Theatre
blurb: Family-friendly stage production of the classic tale at Sarasota's downtown theatre hub. Final week; ticketed, see FST for showtimes and prices.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Florida's iconic downtown market with local produce, flowers, baked goods and prepared foods. Free to browse, a perfect Saturday-morning stroll through downtown Sarasota.

name: Siesta Key Beach Drum Circle
blurb: Weekly sunset gathering on world-famous Siesta Beach with drummers, dancers and fire spinners. Free and a signature Siesta Key experience.
